resources.string: After you read and accept the disclosure, this service uses tablet motion and permitted screen images in memory to animate opening and closing. You can choose home and lock screen only, or other permitted apps too. App images may contain sensitive visible information. It reads window ownership, not view text or keystrokes, and does not perform gestures or unlock the device. Motion sensing runs in eligible scenes while the display is on and stops when off or paused. Screenshots are requested only when an animation is triggered, not recorded continuously. No network access, screenshot files or uploads. Protected ordinary apps and permission pages are skipped. A protected lock screen may use shading. Pause or withdraw consent in TabFold or disable this service.
Check the device requirements below. You can still read the help and risk information.
Understand how the animation uses screen images and motion data, then choose whether to continue.
Tap the button below, choose Installed apps (or Downloaded apps), then turn on “%1$s” and confirm the system prompt. Return here when finished.
Permission is on. Waiting for Android to connect the service…
Place the keyboard flat on a table, keep the tablet in landscape, then open it to your normal working angle. Hold it still and tap the button below.
The service and calibration are ready. Start to return to your home screen and see a short preview.
Slowly fold or open the tablet in your selected scenes. Keep the keyboard flat and stationary. You do not need to keep this page open.

Go to home screen and preview
Android may restrict sensitive permissions based on how an app was installed. Only continue if you trust this TabFold build. This confirmation is separate from turning on the accessibility service.
2. On the system app-info page, tap ⋮ in the top-right and choose “Allow restricted settings”. Samsung Chinese menus may call it “允许限制性设置”.
3. Confirm using the system prompt, PIN or biometrics if requested.
4. Return here, open accessibility settings, then enable the TabFold service.

No menu or still blocked? First attempt to enable the service once, then check app info again. Menu availability can vary with One UI, installation source and device-management policies. If it is still missing, share a device report through the project. TabFold cannot grant its own permission or override a system policy.
A physical keyboard is connected, but not recognized as a Book Cover. If this is your intended keyboard, allow it below.

Open to 45°–160° and keep the keyboard level without sideways tilt.
Open position saved. Continue to the next step.
Place the keyboard flat, open the screen to a comfortable angle, then save the position.
Motion data is unavailable. Check the device requirements or try reopening the app.

Personal interest · Free and open source · Unofficial
TabFold is a free, experimental open-source animation tool. It is not an official Samsung, Google or Apple product.

Accessibility recognizes the current app and uses permitted screen images briefly in memory. If you include other apps below, their visible content may contain messages, account details or other sensitive information. TabFold does not save or upload images and has no network permission.
Motion sensing and rendering may increase battery use and heat. Animations may be delayed, flicker or temporarily freeze the displayed image.
Compatibility is not guaranteed for every model. Back up important data and keep the keyboard flat. Stop using the app if problems occur.
The software is provided as is. Warranty exclusions and liability limits apply only where the law permits; non-excludable rights and liabilities remain unaffected.
I have read and understood this information and voluntarily choose the described local processing.

Android 14 or newer. Keeps motion detection active while the display is on. Permitted app images are used briefly for animation; protected pages and permission screens are skipped.

Background detection uses an ongoing notification with a Pause button. Allow notifications when prompted to see it. Motion detection stops with the display off. Force-stopping or system power management can still interrupt the service.
Detecting motion while the screen is on. Tap to open settings.
